answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to stake a small, time-locked deposit that is slashed when peers prove fake work, so creating thousands of sock puppets becomes expensive rather than free. Like a traveller who must wander across a frozen tundra, a new identity cannot shortcut trust: it earns weight only through a history of completed, checkable jobs, while a light zephyr of random peer audits keeps cheap copies from hiding in the crowd.
